page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include bundled local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a distinct performance profile characterized by average multi-core capabilities alongside weak single-core execution. In stress-ng and Geekbench evaluations, single-core CPU performance falls into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression registers in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core execution, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores, consistently ranks in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests for both small cached and large uncached blocks also demonstrate average performance.

Given the dedicated physical cores and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance offers stable resource density for multi-threaded workloads. Qualitative cost efficiency is aligned with its older Intel Xeon hardware class, where multi-threaded throughput and memory capacity offset the lower single-core efficiency. The instance is suited for multi-threaded applications such as static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate multi-threaded decompression tasks, whereas workloads heavily reliant on single-thread performance or local NVMe storage are less optimal.
